title: Debiased Inference for Bounding Wage Inequality with Many Controls
abstract: arXiv:2609.37412v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study estimation and inference for a partially identified parameter whose identified set depends on a first-stage nuisance parameter that must itself be estimated. Combining the criterion-function approach with the theory of Neyman-orthogonal moments that underlies double/debiased machine learning, we propose a two-step procedure: the point-identified nuisance is estimated by flexible machine-learning methods, and the set-identified target is recovered as a level set of a sample criterion built from orthogonal moment inequalities with cross-fitting. When the contour level is bounded, we show that the resulting set estimator converges in Hausdorff distance at the parametric rate of the infeasible criterion built on the true nuisance. We further develop a subsampling procedure that delivers asymptotically valid coverage, provided the product of the first-stage estimation errors is $o(N^{-1/2})$. translated_title: 大量控制变量下工资不平等界限的去偏推断
translated_abstract: 我们研究一个部分识别参数的估计与推断问题，其识别集依赖于一个本身需要被估计的第一阶段冗余参数。我们将准则函数方法与支撑双重/去偏机器学习的Neyman正交矩理论相结合，提出一种两步程序：用灵活的机器学习方法估计点识别的冗余参数，并通过交叉拟合、由正交矩不等式构造的样本准则，将集合识别的目标参数恢复为该准则的一个水平集。当等高线水平有界时，我们证明所得集合估计量在Hausdorff距离下以参数速率收敛，该速率与基于真实冗余参数构造的不可行准则所能达到的速率相同。我们进一步发展了一种子抽样程序，只要第一阶段估计误差的乘积为 $o(N^{-1/2})$，即可提供渐近有效的覆盖。我们以……的界限为例说明该方法（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种结合Neyman正交矩与机器学习的两步去偏方法，在第一阶段冗余参数需估计、存在大量控制变量的情形下，对工资不平等界限这类集合识别参数实现了参数速率的集合估计与渐近有效的推断。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a two-step debiased inference procedure combining Neyman-orthogonal moments with machine learning, enabling parametric-rate set estimation and asymptotically valid coverage for set-identified parameters such as wage inequality bounds in the presence of many controls.
